MTT-R0101.seoTitle: Custom Perfume Lift-Off Lid Box | Gloss & Silver Foil
MTT-R0101.seoDescription: Custom perfume lid-and-base packaging with a separate cap, fitted bottle cavity and gloss finish. Compare opening, insert fit and sample requirements.
answer: A separate-lid rigid box for a single perfume bottle, with a gloss-printed wrap and silver foil accents. The cap lifts completely away from the base; it is not a hinged magnetic box.
适合单瓶香水展示的天地盖硬盒，采用亮膜印刷裱纸与银色烫箔。上盖与底盒完全分离，不是磁吸翻盖。
selection: Choose this separate-lid structure when the bottle should be fully visible after opening and the buyer can put the lid aside. Start with the bottle and insert layout before setting the outer box size. A taller lid changes how much of the bottle is revealed; a very shallow lid leaves more of the base visible. Compare a hinged book-style box when the lid must stay attached, or a folding carton when flat storage and a lighter retail pack take priority. This presentation box still needs a separately reviewed outer pack for parcel delivery.
需要开盖后完整展示瓶器，且使用者可以将盒盖放在旁边时，可选天地盖。应先确定瓶器与内托布局，再定外盒尺寸。盖高影响开盖过程中的展示比例，浅盖会露出更多底盒。要求盒盖始终连接时比较书型盒；更重视折平储存与轻量零售包装时比较卡纸盒。用于快递时，展示盒仍需另行评估外层运输包装。
review: Provide the filled bottle, fitted cap dimensions, total weight and any projecting decoration. Review the lid-and-base fit separately from the bottle cavity: a comfortable opening does not prove that the bottle is held securely. Check whether the bottle can be lifted by its body without pulling on a decorative cap. For this gloss-and-silver-foil design, use the actual wrapped paper sample to review foil alignment across printed details and visible scuffing after normal handling. Record the agreed appearance and opening feel on the approved sample rather than assigning a universal clearance. Send bottle photos, dimensions, quantity and delivery format to start the sample brief. Record the bottle maximum width and depth at the shoulder as well as the base. Confirm whether the illustrated pouch is supplied loose or needs its own packed space; do not size the bottle cavity around the pouch.

提供装液瓶器、装好瓶盖后的尺寸、总重量及突出装饰。盖底配合与瓶器内腔应分开检查：开盖顺畅并不能证明瓶器固定可靠。检查能否握住瓶身取出产品，避免拉拽装饰瓶盖。此款亮面与银箔组合应以实际裱纸样品检查印刷细节上的烫箔对位，以及正常取放后的可见擦痕。将商定外观与开盖手感记录在确认样上，不套用统一间隙。请提供瓶器照片、尺寸、数量和交付方式，以便准备打样需求。 同时记录瓶肩与瓶底的最大宽深。确认图示束口袋是独立配件还是需要盒内空间，不要按束口袋尺寸确定瓶器槽位。

MTT-R0103.seoTitle: Custom Magnetic Skincare Gift Box | Textured Wrap
MTT-R0103.seoDescription: Plan a magnetic skincare gift box with one jar and two bottle positions. Review linen-textured wrap, debossing, removal access and closure clearance.
answer: A hinged rigid skincare set box with a jar position beside two bottle positions. Linen-textured wrap and a debossed border give a tactile surface rather than a high-gloss finish.
带铰接盖的护肤套装硬盒，内托为一罐两瓶布局；细麻纹裱纸与压凹边框强调触感。
selection: Use this for a set that opens as one presentation. Choose a separate carton for each item if units need independent retail sale; the set box and individual cartons can share artwork without sharing the same construction.
适合一次打开展示整套产品。如每件需要独立零售，可为单品另配卡纸盒；套盒和单品盒可共用视觉元素，但结构应分别确认。
review: Send each jar and bottle size with closures fitted and the loaded set weight. Check that the lid and magnet area clear the tallest item. Test finger access and deboss definition on the selected textured wrap.
提供每个瓶罐装好盖后的尺寸及整套重量。检查盖面、磁吸位置与最高产品的间隙，并测试取放空间和纹理纸上的压凹清晰度。

MTT-R0202.seoTitle: Custom Coffee Tasting Drawer Gift Box | Four Compartments
MTT-R0202.seoDescription: Explore a four-compartment coffee tasting drawer box for sealed pouches, with printed wrap, a sliding tray and coordinated cards or ribbon.
answer: A rigid sleeve and sliding tray organize four sealed coffee pouches into a tasting set. The gloss-printed wrap creates a bright presentation; the paper box does not replace the coffee pouch barrier.
硬质外套与抽屉内匣组成四格咖啡品鉴套盒，亮膜印刷形成鲜明展示；纸盒不能替代咖啡密封袋的阻隔功能。
selection: Choose a drawer for a gradual reveal and separate tasting positions. If empty-pack shipping volume is the priority, compare a folding carton. Measure the actual sealed pouch rather than using its nominal fill weight as a size.
抽屉适合渐进式开箱与分格展示。若优先降低空包装体积，可比较折叠卡纸盒；尺寸应测量封口后的实际包装袋，不能从净含量推算。
review: Include pouch seams and any valve in measurements. Check tray movement with all four pouches loaded, removal access and the pull attachment. Confirm whether tasting cards sit above the products or in a separate pocket.
测量时包含封边及排气阀。装满四袋后测试抽拉、取放和拉带连接，并确认品鉴卡放在产品上方还是另设卡位。

MTT-R0303.seoTitle: Custom Collagen Gift Set Box | Matte & Spot UV
MTT-R0303.seoDescription: Custom collagen set packaging with a tub well and sachet compartment. Review magnetic opening, matte wrap, selective gloss UV and the packed sample.
answer: A magnetic book-style box groups a sealed tub and sachets. Matte lamination with selective gloss UV creates contrast in the printed surface without changing the rigid opening structure.
磁吸书型盒组合展示密封罐和小袋装产品；哑膜与局部亮 UV 形成表面反差，开合结构仍为硬质翻盖。
selection: Choose this for a coordinated routine or gift set. For individual refills, a separate folding carton may be more appropriate. The outer gift box does not establish shelf life or replace the product’s sealed primary pack.
适合组合使用套装或赠礼。独立补充装可考虑卡纸盒；外层礼盒不能证明保质期，也不能替代产品密封内包装。
review: Provide the tub diameter and height, sachet stack size and full set weight. Check the lid over the tub, sachet retrieval and UV alignment using a separate finish mask. Keep batch information readable and accessible on the sealed products.
提供罐体直径、高度、小袋堆叠尺寸和整套重量。检查罐顶净空、小袋取放，并用独立工艺图层确认 UV 位置；保留内装产品批次信息的可读性与查看方式。

MTT-R0401.seoTitle: Custom Ring Keepsake Box | Cloth Wrap & Lift-Off Lid
MTT-R0401.seoDescription: Cloth-wrapped ring keepsake packaging with a removable lid and fabric-lined ring slit. Review ring fit, lid clearance and foil on the chosen cloth.
answer: A small rigid lid-and-base keepsake box with bookcloth wrap and a fabric-lined ring slit. The silver motif is a surface finish; the lid is fully removable.
小型天地盖收藏盒，外覆装帧布、内设织物衬里的戒指插槽；银色图案为表面工艺，上盖可完全取下。
selection: Choose this for a ring presentation with a textile feel. A hinged presentation box is a different opening option. Do not assume the lining is anti-tarnish or suitable for every metal and gemstone without material review.
适合强调织物触感的戒指展示。若需要连体开合，可另选翻盖结构；未经材料核实，不应认定内衬具备防氧化性能或适用于所有金属与宝石。
review: Provide band width, ring size and the maximum setting height. Test insertion and removal without snagging, lid clearance over the stone and foil readability across the cloth texture.
提供戒圈尺寸、戒臂宽度及镶嵌部位最大高度。测试插取是否勾挂、宝石上方净空，以及布纹上的烫箔清晰度。

MTT-R0507.seoTitle: Custom Hexagonal Sweets Gift Box | Six Compartments
MTT-R0507.seoDescription: Hexagonal rigid gift packaging for individually wrapped sweets, with six compartments, dyed paper and gold foil. Review fit and separate-lid alignment.
answer: A six-sided rigid base and matching removable cap create a festival gift format with six wrapped-sweet compartments. The polygon is structural, not a rectangular box printed to look hexagonal.
六边形硬质底盒配独立六边形上盖，内设六格独立包装糖点位置；外形来自真实多边结构，而非矩形盒上的印刷装饰。
selection: Choose this when a distinctive outline matters more than rectangular packing efficiency. Compare a rectangular gift box if shelf or master-carton space is tight. Plan around individually wrapped contents unless the intended food-contact materials are separately approved.
适合重视独特轮廓的节日礼赠。若货架或外箱空间紧张，可比较矩形礼盒。优先按独立包装内容物规划；直接接触食品的材料须另行确认。
review: Send wrapped-piece sizes and the proposed arrangement. Confirm the internal usable area, corner joints, cap alignment and removal of every piece. Review the foil registration and any card or ribbon with the assembled sample.
提供包好后每件尺寸及排列方式。确认内部可用空间、转角接缝、上盖对位及每格取放，并在组装样品上核对烫箔、卡片和丝带。

MTT-C0104.seoTitle: Custom Skincare Crash-Lock Carton | Printed Kraft
MTT-C0104.seoDescription: Printed kraft skincare carton with a pre-glued crash-lock base, tuck top and paperboard support. Review bottle sizes, base assembly and print opacity.
answer: A kraft paperboard carton with a pre-glued crash-lock bottom and tuck top. Folded paperboard support separates the skincare pair; this is a folding carton, not a rigid magnetic gift box.
牛皮卡纸盒采用预糊自动扣底与上插口结构，折叠纸托分隔两件护肤品；属于卡纸折叠盒，不是磁吸精品硬盒。
selection: Choose this when a folding retail pack and bottom assembly are important. The base is not a guarantee of load capacity. For a heavier glass pair, compare the complete support and shipping pack before selecting the board.
适合重视折叠零售包装和扣底组装的项目。扣底结构不等于承重保证；较重玻璃瓶组合应先评估完整支撑与运输包装，再确定纸板。
review: Provide both assembled bottle sizes and filled weights. Check base engagement with the contents loaded, bottle separation and top-flap clearance. Approve opaque colours on actual kraft, since its base colour affects the print.
提供两瓶装配后尺寸与装液重量。装入产品后检查扣底到位、瓶间隔离及顶舌净空；牛皮纸底色会影响印色，应确认实纸上的遮盖色效果。

MTT-C0112.seoTitle: Custom Macaron Window Carton | Sealed Product Display
MTT-C0112.seoDescription: Window tuck carton for sealed macarons with paperboard support and matte/spot-UV print. Review tray dimensions, window attachment and food-pack scope.
answer: A white paperboard tuck carton shows sealed macarons through a small film window. The tuck tongue and dust flaps close the top; the window is separate from the sealed food pack inside.
白卡插口盒通过透明膜窗口展示密封包装马卡龙；顶部由插舌与防尘翼关闭，外盒窗口与内部食品密封包装是不同部件。
selection: Choose this when the actual product should be visible on the shelf. Use an enclosed carton if light exposure or concealment is a concern. Do not infer food-contact suitability or shelf life from the window image.
适合需要在货架上看见实物的产品。若需要遮光或隐藏内容物，可选择封闭盒。不能从开窗图片推断食品接触适用性或保质期。
review: Measure the sealed tray, including flange and lid, and state storage conditions and destination. Check window adhesion, remaining board border and product movement. Review the material documentation for the intended use rather than relying on a generic “food grade” label.
测量密封托盘的边沿与盖子，说明储存条件和目的地。检查贴窗牢固度、窗口周围纸框及产品移动；按预期用途确认材料文件，不能只看泛泛的“食品级”字样。

MTT-C0128.seoTitle: Custom Festive Pillow Carton | Printed Kraft Gift Pack
MTT-C0128.seoDescription: Curved pillow carton for wrapped confectionery with opaque printing on kraft. Review usable volume, crescent end closures and optional gift accessories.
answer: A curved kraft pillow carton with overlapping crescent end flaps holds wrapped confectionery. It opens at a curved end and has no rigid tray or magnetic hinge.
弧形牛皮卡纸枕形盒采用重叠月牙端翼闭合，用于独立包装糖果；从弧形端部打开，没有硬质内匣或磁吸铰接盖。
selection: Choose this for a compact festive handout with a distinctive silhouette. Compare a compartmented rigid box when fragile pieces need separate positions. The curved ends reduce usable space relative to the outer outline.
适合外形鲜明的小型节庆赠礼。易碎内容物若需逐格定位，可比较分格硬盒；弧形端部会减少外轮廓以内的有效容积。
review: Send wrapped-piece sizes, count and total weight. Load the sample to confirm the ends close without crushing products or springing open. Keep key artwork clear of curved folds and decide how the optional card or ribbon is attached.
提供单件包装尺寸、数量和总重。装样后检查端翼是否挤压产品或弹开；重点图文避开弧形折线，并确认可选卡片、丝带的固定方式。

MTT-E0103.seoTitle: Custom Perfume Corrugated Mailer | Printed Roll-End Box
MTT-E0103.seoDescription: Printed corrugated perfume mailer with a rear-hinged lid and fitted paper support. Review bottle retention, closures and the complete transit sample.
answer: A white-lined corrugated roll-end mailer with a rear-hinged lid, side wings and paper support. This is shipping-oriented corrugated construction, distinct from a wrapped rigid book box.
白面瓦楞飞机盒带后连盖、侧插翼与纸质支撑，属于面向运输的瓦楞结构，与裱糊硬质书型盒不同。
selection: Choose this for a branded parcel format, subject to a loaded-pack review. A bottle insert alone does not prove transit protection. A rigid gift box can be an inner presentation layer if the complete mailer is resized around it.
适合品牌化包裹场景，但需评估装实物后的完整包装。仅有瓶托不能证明运输保护；如内配精品礼盒，应围绕礼盒重新确定外层飞机盒尺寸。
review: Provide the filled bottle weight, cap geometry and whether a retail box sits inside. Check restraint, closure, flute direction and packed dimensions. Agree transport testing and carrier acceptance separately for the actual product and route.
提供装液重量、瓶盖形状及是否内含零售盒。检查限位、闭合、楞向和装箱尺寸；运输测试及承运要求需按实际产品与线路单独确认。

MTT-E0104.seoTitle: Custom Skincare Shipping Carton | Four-Flap Corrugated
MTT-E0104.seoDescription: Kraft corrugated shipping carton for skincare sets with four top flaps and paper support. Specify packed weight, dividers, sealing and delivery route.
answer: A kraft-lined corrugated carton closes with two short inner flaps and two long outer flaps. Two-colour printing identifies the pack; paper support is developed around the loaded skincare set.
牛皮面瓦楞箱采用两片短内摇盖和两片长外摇盖闭合，以双色印刷识别包装，纸支撑按实际护肤套装设计。
selection: Choose this for a transport outer pack, not for a magnetic gift-box opening. If the customer receives a presentation box inside, measure that finished box as part of the shipment and keep the two layers distinct in the quote.
适合作为运输外包装，不属于磁吸礼盒开箱方式。若内部含展示礼盒，应将成品礼盒作为装箱对象测量，并在报价中分清两层。
review: State units per carton, full packed weight, dimensions and destination. Review partitions, void space, bottom and top sealing, and the expected stacking conditions. Confirm board grade and test plan from that information rather than appearance.
说明每箱数量、装箱总重、尺寸及目的地。检查隔板、空隙、上下封箱和预期堆码条件，依据这些信息确认纸板等级与测试方案，而不是凭外观判断。

MTT-B0110.seoTitle: Custom Reed Diffuser Paper Bag | Twisted Handles
MTT-B0110.seoDescription: Printed kraft shopping bag for a boxed reed diffuser, with twisted-paper handles and optional tissue. Review bag dimensions, reinforcement and loaded carrying.
answer: A printed kraft shopping bag with twisted-paper handles for carrying a boxed reed diffuser. Side gussets and a folded bottom define the bag shape; tissue can be specified separately.
印刷牛皮纸手提袋配扭绳纸提手，用于携带已包装的香薰产品；袋侧风琴位与折底形成袋体，薄页纸可另外选配。
selection: Choose this as the retail carrying layer of a coordinated set. It does not replace a bottle support, leak-control arrangement or parcel carton. Match the bag to the finished outer box, not just to the glass bottle.
适合作为整套包装的零售携带层，不能替代瓶器支撑、防漏安排或快递外箱。袋子应按成品外盒选配，而非只按玻璃瓶尺寸。
review: Specify bag width × side gusset × height, the boxed product size, reed length if separate, and loaded weight. Test insertion, removal, handle attachment and base integrity with the full set. Confirm tissue, card and print colours together.
袋尺寸按袋宽 × 侧宽 × 袋高标注，并提供成品盒尺寸、单独放置时的藤条长度和装载重量。整套装入后检查取放、提手连接和底部完整性，一起确认薄页纸、卡片与印色。

MTT-R1201.seoTitle: Custom Perfume duo Fold-Flat Gift Box | MTT
MTT-R1201.seoDescription: Custom perfume duo collapsible rigid packaging in cobalt blue and orange. See magnetic closure, fitted insert, paper finish and flat-pack view. Request a sample.
answer: A one-piece magnetic rigid presentation box for two perfume bottles, with two bottle positions and card space. The insert is removable so the empty shell can be supplied flat before assembly.
为双瓶香水配置的一体式磁吸硬盒，带双瓶定位与卡片位。内托可取出，空盒壳可在组装前折平。
selection: Choose this when a connected lid and flat delivery are useful. Compare a fixed rigid box if permanent assembly is preferred. Flat-pack savings depend on the final carton layout and separately packed inserts.
需要一体连接盒盖和折平交付时可选。若希望永久成型，可比较固定硬盒。节省空间取决于最终装箱方式及内托单独包装体积。
review: Confirm product height, insert removal, corner fixing, hinge clearance and magnetic alignment. Confirm whether the selected corner fixing permits repeat folding; review the full shipping pack separately. Provide actual filled product dimensions and weight, quantity and destination.
确认产品高度、内托取放、四角固定、折位间隙及磁吸对位。确认所选四角固定方式是否允许重复折叠，并单独审核完整运输包装。 提供实际装满后的产品尺寸、重量、数量和目的地。

MTT-R1202.seoTitle: Custom Travel fragrance set Fold-Flat Gift Box | MTT
MTT-R1202.seoDescription: Custom travel fragrance set collapsible rigid packaging in coral and ivory. See magnetic closure, fitted insert, paper finish and flat-pack view. Request a sample.
answer: A one-piece magnetic rigid presentation box for four travel perfume vials, with four vial channels and card space. The insert is removable so the empty shell can be supplied flat before assembly.
为四支便携香水配置的一体式磁吸硬盒，带四支香水槽与卡片位。内托可取出，空盒壳可在组装前折平。
selection: Choose this when a connected lid and flat delivery are useful. Compare a fixed rigid box if permanent assembly is preferred. Flat-pack savings depend on the final carton layout and separately packed inserts.
需要一体连接盒盖和折平交付时可选。若希望永久成型，可比较固定硬盒。节省空间取决于最终装箱方式及内托单独包装体积。
review: Confirm product height, insert removal, corner fixing, hinge clearance and magnetic alignment. Confirm whether the selected corner fixing permits repeat folding; review the full shipping pack separately. Provide actual filled product dimensions and weight, quantity and destination.
确认产品高度、内托取放、四角固定、折位间隙及磁吸对位。确认所选四角固定方式是否允许重复折叠，并单独审核完整运输包装。 提供实际装满后的产品尺寸、重量、数量和目的地。

MTT-R1203.seoTitle: Custom Skincare ritual Fold-Flat Gift Box | MTT
MTT-R1203.seoDescription: Custom skincare ritual collapsible rigid packaging in lilac and lime. See magnetic closure, fitted insert, paper finish and flat-pack view. Request a sample.
answer: This fold-flat magnetic box is a candidate for a skincare set combining a wide cream jar with a taller serum bottle. Separate insert positions let the two containers be presented together, but their support heights need not be identical. Establish the closed-box clearance from the taller filled container with its cap or pump fitted, then review how the shorter jar is supported and removed. The empty shell folds flat; the filled set does not.
这款磁吸折叠硬盒适合评估由宽面霜罐和较高精华瓶组成的护肤套装。内托分区让两种容器一起展示，但支撑高度不必相同。应以装好瓶盖或泵头后的较高容器确认合盖净空，再检查较矮面霜罐的支撑及取放。可折平的是空盒壳，而不是装满产品后的礼盒。
selection: Consider this structure when empty-box storage or delivery volume matters and the packing site can assemble the corners and install the insert consistently. Compare a permanently assembled rigid box when packing speed or avoiding assembly variation is more important. Ask for two complete packing layouts: flat shells plus separately packed inserts, and assembled boxes with inserts fitted. Compare carton dimensions, units per carton and assembly work before claiming a freight saving; a bulky insert can reduce the benefit of a flat shell.
如果空盒储存或运输体积重要，且装配现场能够稳定固定四角并安装内托，可考虑此结构。如果更重视装盒速度或希望减少现场组装差异，应比较预先成型的硬盒。要求提供两套完整装箱方案：折平盒壳加单独包装的内托，以及已装好内托的成型盒。比较外箱尺寸、每箱数量和组装工作量后，再评估运费；体积较大的内托会削弱盒壳折平带来的优势。
review: Provide the filled jar and bottle dimensions, weights, closures and intended orientation. On the physical sample, check that support acts on suitable container surfaces rather than loading a pump or dropper; fingers must be able to remove each item without disturbing the other. MTT-C0119.seoTitle: Custom Mooncake Window Carton | Wrapped Food Gift Packaging
MTT-C0119.seoDescription: Compare a window tuck carton for individually wrapped mooncakes: pack fit, display alignment, film attachment and sample checks. Request a project review.
answer: This window tuck carton is a presentation option for individually wrapped mooncakes. The small film-covered opening shows part of the inner pack while the surrounding printed board carries the seasonal design. Size the support around the finished wrapped unit, including the sealed edges and any tray, rather than the bare mooncake. The illustrated metallic paperboard and colour scheme are starting points for a sample brief, not a confirmed food-contact or shelf-life specification.
此开窗插口卡纸盒适用于独立包装月饼的展示。覆膜小窗露出部分内包装，周围印刷卡纸承载节日设计。承托尺寸应以包含封边及可能使用的托盘在内的成品内包装为准，而非裸月饼。图示金属复合卡纸和配色是打样需求的起点，不代表已确认的食品接触或保质期规格。
selection: Choose the window when seeing the wrapped product helps the retail decision. First position the inner pack so its useful detail aligns with the opening; an oversized window will not correct a loose support. Compare a closed tuck carton if the wrapper already hides the product or uninterrupted artwork is more useful. Keep the remaining board border and closure geometry in the structural review. For multi-unit gifts, compare individual supports against a divided tray before enlarging a single cavity.
当看见内包装有助于零售选购时，可考虑开窗。先让内包装的展示部位与窗口对齐；扩大窗口不能解决承托松动。如果内袋已经遮住产品，或完整画面更重要，可比较不开窗的插口盒。结构评估需包含窗口周围保留的纸板边框和封口布局。多枚礼赠应先比较独立承托与分隔托盘，而非直接扩大单个内腔。
review: Supply a sealed product sample, outside dimensions, weight, unit count and planned packing method. Assemble the carton with the actual inner pack and check the tuck tongue closes without catching a seal, the support keeps the display aligned, and the film attachment stays clear of folds and insertion paths. Compare printed colour and metallic appearance on the selected board sample. Confirm all material and contact requirements for the intended market separately; this outer carton should not be treated as the product's moisture or grease barrier without evidence. For shipping, assess the loaded carton inside its complete transit pack.
提供封装后的产品样品、外尺寸、重量、每盒数量和预定装盒方法。用实际内包装装盒，检查插舌是否碰到封边、承托能否保持展示对位、贴窗位置是否避开折线及插入路径。以选定纸板样品比较印刷色彩和金属效果。目标市场的材料与接触要求需另行确认；没有证据时，不应将此外盒当作产品防潮或防油屏障。需要运输时，将装满的卡纸盒放入完整运输包装中评估。

MTT-R0411.seoTitle: Custom Double Ring Gift Box | Two-Slot Lift-Off Design
MTT-R0411.seoDescription: Plan a custom double ring gift box with two lined slots. Compare ring spacing, stone clearance and removable-lid fit, then send dimensions for a sample review.
answer: This double ring gift box holds a pair in two fabric-lined slots beneath a fully removable lid. The matte black and ivory design combines a blind embossed motif with a small foil accent. Start the layout with both rings in their intended display positions: two nominally similar rings can need different slot depths and clearances.
这款双戒指礼盒在独立盒盖下设置两个织物衬里插槽，采用黑色与象牙白哑面设计，配合无色击凸和小面积烫箔。应先将两枚戒指按预期角度摆放；看似相近的戒指也可能需要不同的槽深和间隙。
selection: Choose two slots when the pair should be presented together and each ring can be removed independently. Set the spacing around the widest part of each ring, including projecting stones or settings, rather than dividing the insert into equal halves automatically. Compare a single-ring box when the pieces are sold separately, or a hinged format when keeping the lid attached matters at a counter. The lift-off format gives an unobstructed view, but needs somewhere to place the separate cap.
需要成对展示且每枚可独立取出时，可采用双槽布局。槽距应依据两枚戒指最宽的位置，包括突出宝石与镶座，不宜直接将内托均分。单独销售可比较单戒盒；柜台使用时若希望盒盖保持连接，可比较翻盖结构。天地盖打开后视线无遮挡，但需要放置独立盒盖的位置。
review: Provide both ring sizes, band widths, maximum setting heights and photos from the side. Check that the slots hold each ring without forcing it against the other, and that the lid clears the taller setting after the insert is fitted. Review lining contact and removal on representative samples; a soft-looking fabric alone does not establish scratch resistance or anti-tarnish performance. Approve the embossed motif and foil on the actual matte wrap, especially where small details meet. Send the ring dimensions, order quantity and delivery format so the insert and outer shipping pack can be reviewed together.
请提供两枚戒指的圈号、戒臂宽度、最大镶座高度及侧面照片。检查插槽能否分别固定戒指，避免相互挤压；装入内托后，还应检查较高镶座与盒盖的净空。用代表性实物检查衬料接触与取放；面料看起来柔软，并不能证明防刮或防氧化性能。在实际哑面裱纸上确认击凸和烫箔，尤其关注细小图案交接处。提供戒指尺寸、数量与交付方式，以便同时评估内托和外层运输包装。

MTT-R0615.seoTitle: Custom Accessory Shoulder Box | Padded Insert & Neck
MTT-R0615.seoDescription: Review a custom accessory shoulder box with a padded recess and raised neck. Plan product access, lid fit and finish samples before confirming the specification.
answer: A shoulder-neck rigid box for a boutique accessory, with one padded recess and a removable lid that fits over a raised inner neck. The deep teal and sand design uses pearlescent wrap, matte printing and selective gloss. The visible shoulder is part of the box construction; it should be reviewed alongside product clearance rather than treated as decoration alone.
这款围边天地盖礼盒用于展示精品配饰，内设一个衬垫槽，独立盒盖套合凸起内围框。深青与沙色设计采用珠光裱纸、哑面印刷与局部光油。可见围边属于盒体结构，评估时应同时考虑产品净空，不能只看装饰效果。
selection: Use this structure when a visible band between the lid and base supports the presentation. First establish the accessory position and removal route, then choose the neck height and exposed band. A tall inner neck can restrict finger access to a small item; a deeper padded recess may secure it but make removal harder. Compare a plain lid-and-base box if the shoulder detail adds little value, or a drawer if the product should slide into view. Do not transfer the insert dimensions from one accessory to another without reviewing buckles, clasps or projecting edges.
当盖底之间的可见围边有助于展示时，可采用此结构。先确定配饰位置与取出路径，再确定内围框高度和外露宽度。内围框较高时，小件产品的手指取放空间可能受限；加深衬垫槽可能增强固定，却也可能增加取出难度。如果围边对展示帮助不大，可比较普通天地盖；希望产品随开盒滑出时，可比较抽屉盒。更换配饰时应重新检查搭扣、扣件与突出边缘，不能直接沿用原内槽尺寸。
review: Send the accessory in its packed configuration, its weight and close-up photos of any delicate surface. Check lid fit around the wrapped neck with the insert installed, and lift the product out without dragging it over the rim. Review the pearlescent paper and spot gloss together under the lighting used for approval, since a flat artwork file cannot show the final surface effect. Confirm the approved sample, quantity and shipping format before fixing the specification. For parcel delivery, assess the filled gift box inside its outer shipping pack; the presentation design alone is not evidence of transit protection.
提供配饰包装状态的实物、重量及易损表面近照。安装内托后，检查盒盖与裱纸内围框的套合，并确认取出产品时不需要拖过盒沿。珠光纸与局部光油应在约定的验样光线下组合评估，平面文件无法显示最终表面效果。确定规格前需确认样品、数量和交付方式。快递交付应将装好产品的礼盒与外层运输包装一起评估；展示设计本身不能证明运输保护能力。

answer: A two-tin presentation box for a gift set where both containers should be visible as soon as the lid is removed. The two circular wells define separate positions; the paper box is secondary packaging around the closed tins.
双罐礼赠展示盒，开盖后同时呈现两只茶罐。两个圆形槽分别定位，纸盒作为封闭罐体的外包装。
selection: Choose this layout for a paired assortment and a fully removable lid. Compare the sleeve-and-tray carton when a lighter folded structure matters more than a rigid presentation. For parcel delivery, review a shipping outer carton separately; this gift box alone does not establish transit protection.
需要成对陈列及完全取下的盒盖时选此结构；更重视轻量折叠结构时比较卡纸套筒抽拉盒。快递配送需另评运输外箱，礼盒本身不代表运输保护已合格。
review: Measure both finished tins with lids fitted, including the widest rim or seam, and record filled weights. Confirm the cavity supports the body without trapping the lid, allows finger access and does not let the tins strike each other. Approve the wrap, embossed motif and foil position together on a loaded sample.
测量两只带盖成品罐，包含最宽卷边或接缝，并记录装填重量。确认槽位承托罐身、不夹住罐盖、方便手指取出且两罐不相碰。装入实物后共同审核裱纸、击凸纹样和烫金位置。

answer: A folded paperboard sleeve and tray for presenting a separately closed tea tin. The tray carries the container while the sleeve provides a printable outer surface; it is a different construction from a wrapped rigid drawer box.
用于独立封闭茶罐的折叠卡纸套筒与托盘，托盘承载罐体，套筒提供印刷展示面；结构不同于裱纸硬质抽屉盒。
selection: Use it when a compact retail presentation and folded board construction fit the brief. Compare a rigid lift-off box for a heavier presentation or a paired gift set. Do not choose board grade from an empty mock-up: filled tin weight and the way the tray is held affect the approval.
适合紧凑零售展示与折叠卡纸结构。需要硬挺展示或双罐礼赠时比较天地盖硬盒。不能仅凭空样选纸：罐体装填重量和托盘握持方式都影响审核。
review: Check the maximum tin diameter, lid rim, base seam and total height. Load the tray and withdraw it fully: look for base deflection, snagging at the sleeve opening and a tin that can roll or lift out unintentionally. Compare printed colour and varnish on the approved paperboard, then confirm packing orientation. For the rectangular tin shown, measure the widest lid rim and corner radii, not only the straight body walls. Confirm the loaded tray can be withdrawn without the sleeve catching the lid. The cream tray and printed sleeve are separate surfaces to approve; a matched tin decoration is a separate supply item.
核对罐体最大直径、盖缘、底部接缝及总高度。装载后完整抽出托盘，检查底板下挠、套筒口卡阻以及罐体意外滚动或脱出。用确认的纸板审核印色和上光，再确认装箱方向。 图示方罐需测量最宽盖沿及转角半径，不能只量罐身直壁。装载后确认托盘抽出时套筒不会挂住罐盖。奶油白托盘与印刷套筒应分别确认表面效果，配套罐体装饰属于另一供货项目。

answer: A two-piece rigid presentation box for a fragrance bottle and a smaller refill or travel container. Two unequal cavities give each item its own position. Espresso linen-textured wrapping and a pale-gold printed border support a coordinated retail gift set; the separate lid can be set beside the open base.
用于香水瓶与较小补充装或旅行装的天地盖硬盒。两个不同尺寸的槽位分别定位产品，咖啡棕细布纹裱纸与浅金印刷边框形成成套零售礼赠展示，独立盒盖可放在打开的底盒旁。
selection: Use the unequal layout when both containers should be visible together. Confirm what the second container actually holds before naming it a refill set. If the smaller bottle changes between editions, compare a replaceable insert rather than enlarging both cavities. The raised products must clear the closed lid. Choose a hinged structure only when keeping the cover attached matters to the opening experience.
需要同时展示两件瓶器时选择不等槽布局。命名为补充装套装前，先确认小瓶的实际用途。不同版本的小瓶若有变化，可比较更换内托，而非同时放大两个槽位。产品高出托面的部分应与闭合盒盖保持配合空间；要求盒盖始终连接时再比较翻盖结构。
review: Send separate capped dimensions and filled weights for both bottles, including pump collars. Mark which body surfaces can contact the insert and where fingers can grip each item without pulling its cap. Insert material and cavity depth remain sample decisions. Review the printed border and deboss on the actual textured paper: a colour on screen does not define a metallic foil finish. Approve the loaded layout, lid fit and removal of each bottle independently.
分别提供两瓶装好盖后的尺寸与装填重量，包含泵头圈。标明允许内托接触的瓶身表面，以及无需拉瓶盖即可握持的位置。内托材质与槽深按样品确定。在实际纹理纸上审核印刷边框和压凹，屏幕颜色不能定义金属烫箔效果。分别确认装载布局、盖底配合及两瓶的独立取放。

answer: An open-top, gusseted shopping bag for handing over a boxed perfume purchase at a counter or event. Flat peach ribbon handles complement the emerald-and-peach printed paper. The illustration shows a bottle and pouch arrangement; the bag itself does not provide a fitted protective cavity for bare glass.
适合专柜或活动交付已装盒香水的敞口侧褶手提袋。蜜桃色扁丝带提手搭配祖母绿与蜜桃色印刷纸面。图中展示瓶器与束口袋的搭配，纸袋本身不提供裸玻璃瓶的贴合防护槽。
selection: Size the bag around the finished perfume box, including its lid and any tissue, rather than the bottle alone. Allow access to lift the box through the opening. Ribbon handles suit gift presentation, but their attachment and reinforcement need review under the packed load. Compare a wider gusset for a boxed set; do not use an oversized bag to substitute for bottle restraint.
按香水成品盒确定袋尺寸，包含盒盖及薄页纸，而非只量瓶身；袋口应留出提取盒子的空间。丝带提手适合礼赠展示，但连接和加强结构需按实际装载审核。成套礼盒可比较更宽的侧褶，不能用大袋替代瓶器固定。
review: Provide bag width × gusset × body height in mm, packed box size, total weight and preferred handle drop. Confirm ribbon width, attachment method, top-fold reinforcement and bottom support. Review gloss-laminated colour on the chosen stock, especially at folds and handle attachments. A carrying sample should include the intended contents; tissue and the drawstring pouch are separate accessories to list in the quote.
提供袋宽×侧褶×袋身高（mm）、成品盒尺寸、总重量及期望提手垂高。确认丝带宽度、固定方式、折口加强和袋底支撑。在所选纸材上审核覆亮膜后的颜色，重点检查折位及提手连接处。提携样品应装入计划交付的内容物；薄页纸和束口袋作为独立附件列入报价。

answer: A compact carry bag for a closed tea tin, with reinforced oval hand holes instead of separate ribbon handles. The raspberry-and-copper geometric print wraps the front and side gussets. Use it for a retail handover or tea gift where the customer carries the packed tin from the handle cut-outs.
用于封闭茶罐的紧凑手提袋，以加强椭圆手挽孔替代独立丝带提手。覆盆子粉与铜色几何印刷延伸至正面和侧褶，适合零售交付或茶礼提携。
selection: The tin must sit below the hand-hole area so fingers can pass through both panels. If a pouch or second item is included, map its position beside the tin before deciding the gusset. Compare a taller ribbon-handle bag when the tin leaves insufficient hand clearance. This open bag is a carry pack; parcel shipping requires a separate shipping solution.
茶罐应低于手挽孔区域，使手指可穿过前后袋面。如果另配袋装茶或其他物品，应先安排其与茶罐的相对位置，再定侧褶。茶罐占用手挽空间时可比较更高的丝带手提袋。此敞口袋用于提携，快递寄送需另配运输包装。
review: Measure the closed tin including lid overhang, then record filled weight, bag width × gusset × body height, handle-hole size and the remaining paper above the hole. Agree the reinforcement patch and bottom construction on a sample. Check edge tearing and base distortion with the packed set. Copper is the printed colour shown here; quote metallic foil separately if required.
测量带盖茶罐的最大外廓，包含盖沿外伸，记录装填重量、袋宽×侧褶×袋身高、手挽孔大小及孔上方剩余纸边。通过样品确认加强片和袋底结构，装入整套产品检查孔边撕裂与袋底变形。此处铜色为展示印刷配色，要求金属烫箔时另行列明。

answer: A rear-hinged corrugated mailer for a closed tea tin and an optional separately packed tea pouch. Roll-end side walls frame the load, while fitted paper support or cushioning can control movement. Coral-and-cobalt printing identifies the outer pack; the tin remains the primary container.
用于封闭茶罐及可选独立袋装茶的一体连盖瓦楞飞机盒。卷折侧墙围合装载空间，可通过配合的纸质承托或缓冲限制位移。珊瑚橙与钴蓝印刷构成外包装，茶罐仍为直接容纳产品的容器。
selection: Use this format when packing and dispatch are part of the brief. A tin and soft pouch behave differently under load: separate them so the tin does not bear against the pouch. Compare a fitted divider with loose paper fill where repeated packing consistency matters. The illustration is a layout reference; it does not establish drop resistance, stacking strength or suitability for a particular delivery route.
需求涉及装箱发货时可选此结构。茶罐与软袋受力方式不同，应分隔，避免罐体直接压向软袋。需要稳定重复装箱时，可比较定位隔板与散装纸填充。图片用于布局参考，不能据此确定跌落、堆码性能或特定线路适用性。
review: Supply the closed tin envelope, filled weight, pouch dimensions and packed unit count. Confirm usable box space after the roll-end walls are folded, flute profile, board construction, support layout and sealing method. Trial-pack the actual products and inspect lid clearance, side-lock engagement and movement. Agree a route-appropriate test for the complete pack before making a transport-protection claim; shipping dimensions and gross weight come from the packed sample.
提供带盖茶罐最大外廓、装填重量、软袋尺寸及每盒数量。确认卷折侧墙成型后的可用空间、楞型、纸板组成、承托布局与封箱方式。用实物试装，检查盖内间隙、侧翼锁合及产品位移。对完整包装确定适合运输路线的测试后，再作运输保护声明；发运外尺寸与毛重来自装载样品。

MTT-R0415.seoTitle: Custom Brooch Shoulder-Neck Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0415.seoDescription: Custom brooch packaging in a shoulder-neck box, with one shallow padded brooch recess. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: This shoulder-neck box presents one brooch in a shallow padded recess. The closed clasp on the reverse helps determine the recess depth.
这款肩颈盒用浅垫槽展示一枚胸针，背面扣件合上后的厚度会影响槽深。
selection: Choose this format for a brooch that lies face up. For a curved piece, compare a shaped support that leaves clearance around the clasp.
可正面朝上平放的胸针适合浅槽。对于弧度较大的款式，可比较仿形支撑，并为背扣留出空间。
review: Send the face length and width, total depth with the clasp closed and a side photo. Close the sample lid over the mounted brooch, check clearance at the highest setting and lift the piece out without pulling on the pin.
请提供正面长宽、合扣后的总厚度和侧面照片。将胸针装入样盒后合盖，检查最高镶嵌点是否碰盖，再确认能握住主体取出。

MTT-R0609.seoTitle: Custom Candle Gift Round Lift-Off Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0609.seoDescription: Custom candle gift packaging in a round lift-off box, with one round jar recess. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: The round lift-off box holds one upright candle jar. Size the recess to the jar body and check lid clearance against the capped height.
这款圆形天地盖盒用于单罐直立展示。按罐身核对槽径，按带盖总高核对盒盖净空。
selection: A cap that overhangs the jar body needs more room at the top. Mark the support point and the widest cap diameter separately on the insert drawing.
如果罐盖比罐身宽，顶部需要额外空间。请在内托图上分别标明支撑位置与罐盖最大直径。
review: Send body and cap diameters, capped height and filled weight. Try the filled jar in the sample, check movement at the base and confirm a finger grip for removal. For parcel delivery, review the outer shipper with the loaded gift box.
请提供罐身与罐盖直径、带盖总高及装填重量。用装满的罐子试装，检查底部晃动及取出时的手指空间。快递运输时另用装载后的礼盒审核外箱。

MTT-R0104.seoTitle: Custom Perfume Discovery Set Double-Door Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0104.seoDescription: Custom perfume discovery set packaging in a double-door box, with six narrow vial channels. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: Six narrow channels present a fragrance discovery set behind two doors that meet in the centre.
六条窄槽分别安放试香管，两扇盒门在中间闭合。
selection: Compare the longest capped vial with the others before approving one repeated channel. A wider spray collar can change how a vial sits.
签样前比较各支试香管带盖长度。喷头肩部较宽时，还要核对入槽位置。
review: Send each capped length, maximum collar diameter and the intended label orientation. Load all six positions, remove a middle vial and close both doors to check clearance.
提供每支带盖长度、喷头最大直径及标签朝向。试装六支，从中间取出一支，再合上两扇门检查净空。

MTT-C0103.seoTitle: Custom Perfume Bottle Tuck-end carton | MTT Packaging
MTT-C0103.seoDescription: Custom perfume bottle packaging with tuck-end carton construction, coated folding boxboard and gloss varnish and vivid colour printing. Tailor size, artwork and quantity with MTT.
answer: A tuck-end folding carton surrounds one bottle. A folded paperboard support locates it inside the carton.
插舌折叠彩盒装一瓶香水，内部用折叠纸板定位。
selection: For a tall pump, compare the tuck tongue’s path with the space above the pump collar before fixing the carton height.
若泵头较高，定盒高前先核对插舌折入路径与泵颈上方空间。
review: Send the filled weight, footprint and total height with the cap on. Assemble the support with a bottle sample and check that both dust flaps and the tongue close freely.
提供装填重量、瓶底长宽和带盖总高。用实瓶组装纸托，确认防尘翼和插舌均可顺利闭合。

MTT-B0102.seoTitle: Custom Single wine cotton-handle paper bag | MTT Packaging
MTT-B0102.seoDescription: Single wine cotton-handle paper bag with reinforced rectangular bottom and folded top and small copper foil grape motif. Customize dimensions, artwork and optional accessories with MTT.
answer: Cotton cords pass through the reinforced folded top of this tall, gusseted wine bag.
这款高身酒袋两侧有侧褶，棉绳穿过加强的折口。
selection: A boxed bottle needs a different opening and base footprint from a bare bottle. Measure the version the customer will actually carry.
裸瓶和带盒酒瓶需要的袋口及底面积不同，请测量顾客实际提走的包装。
review: Give the packed width, depth, height and total weight. Check the bottom sits flat and that the cord attachment leaves room for the bottle neck and the hand.
提供装好后的宽、深、高及总重。试装时检查袋底能否平放，以及绳结处是否留有瓶颈和手部净空。

MTT-B0107.seoTitle: Custom Wrapped Chocolates Die-cut handle paper bag | MTT Packaging
MTT-B0107.seoDescription: Custom wrapped chocolates packaging with die-cut handle paper bag construction, pearlescent shopping-bag paper and pearlescent sheen and colour printing. Tailor size, artwork and quantity with MTT.
answer: This gusseted chocolate bag uses reinforced oval hand holes cut into the top panel.
这款巧克力手提袋带侧褶，手提位是袋口板上的加强椭圆冲孔。
selection: For a boxed assortment, check the top edge of the box against the lower edge of the hand hole. The grip needs room above the contents.
盒装巧克力应比较盒顶与提手孔下缘的位置，为握持留出空间。
review: Send the complete retail pack footprint and height, its weight and the preferred carrying orientation. Try inserting and lifting the filled pack through the actual die-cut grip.
提供整套零售包装的底面尺寸、高度、重量和提携方向。使用打样袋试装，通过冲孔提手提起实物检查。

MTT-R0215.seoTitle: Custom Coffee Tin Shoulder-Neck Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0215.seoDescription: Custom coffee tin packaging in a shoulder-neck box, with one large circular tin cavity. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: A shoulder-neck gift box presents one coffee tin in a circular recess. The gift-box lid fits over a raised inner neck.
这款肩颈礼盒用圆槽安放一个咖啡罐，外盒盖套在凸起的内颈上。
selection: Check the tin rim against the access opening and the box lid against the capped tin. A cavity sized from the body alone can leave the rim difficult to grasp.
核对罐沿与取放口、罐盖与礼盒盖的净空。只按罐身定槽径，可能难以抓住罐沿。
review: Supply body and rim diameters, capped height and filled weight. With the actual tin seated, check removal access and whether the outer lid settles onto the shoulder.
提供罐身及罐沿直径、带盖高度和装填重量。将实罐放入后检查取出空间，并确认外盖能落到肩位。

MTT-R0319.seoTitle: Custom Supplement Tin Round Lift-Off Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0319.seoDescription: Custom supplement tin packaging in a round lift-off box, with one cylindrical container well. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: A cylindrical recess holds one supplement tin inside a round presentation box with a separate cap.
圆形展示盒内有一个圆柱形罐槽，外盒盖可独立取下。
selection: The retail tin and the paper gift box have separate closures. Establish the approved sealed tin size before choosing the gift-box recess.
零售罐和纸礼盒各有自己的盖。先确定已封装罐的成品尺寸，再定外盒内槽。
review: Provide the widest measurement of the sealed tin, total height and filled mass. On the assembled sample, lift out the tin and check clearance around its seal and label.
提供封装罐最大外径、总高和装填重量。用组装样试取实罐，核对封签及标签周围的净空。

MTT-R0407.seoTitle: Custom Gemstone Necklace Hexagonal Lift-Off Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0407.seoDescription: Custom gemstone necklace packaging in a hexagonal lift-off box, with one shaped necklace presentation pad. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: The shaped pad sits inside a six-sided lift-off box. Use the outline of the necklace as worn to plan its position on the pad.
selection: For a pendant with a projecting stone, send the pendant width, drop and deepest setting in mm, plus the length of chain that must sit behind the pad.
review: Mount the actual necklace, lift and reseat the pad, then close the lid. Check the setting clears the lid and the concealed clasp does not push the pad up.

MTT-R0408.seoTitle: Custom Earring Collection Two-Drawer Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0408.seoDescription: Custom earring collection packaging in a two-drawer box, with six small lined compartments per drawer. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: Each of the two shallow drawers has six small lined compartments. Decide whether each cell presents a pair or a single earring before sizing the dividers.
selection: Measure each pair in its display position with backs fitted. A hoop needs space across the cell, while a stud post can determine the usable drawer height.
review: Fill both drawers and slide them fully closed. Check that posts clear the drawer above and that a customer can lift out a pair by its body without catching the lining.

MTT-R0413.seoTitle: Custom Pearl Necklace Magnetic Book Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0413.seoDescription: Custom pearl necklace packaging in a magnetic book box, with one broad curved necklace pad. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: The broad curved pad presents a pearl strand in a magnetic book box. Lay the actual strand on a paper outline before choosing the pad width.
selection: Send the strand length, largest bead diameter and clasp dimensions. Mark where the clasp sits and how much of the strand you want visible when the lid opens.
review: Close the sample slowly and watch the section nearest the hinge. Open it again and check that the strand lies in the approved curve and lifts clear without tightening around the pad.

MTT-R0802.seoTitle: Custom Candle Jar Rigid Gift Box | Shoulder-Neck Lid
MTT-R0802.seoDescription: Amber candle jar presentation box in ivory and terracotta, with paperboard insert around candle jar. A separate lid fits over a raised shoulder; it is not hinged. Customize size and quantities with MTT.
answer: A paperboard insert locates the candle jar inside a shoulder-neck gift box. The removable lid seats over the raised shoulder.
selection: Record the jar diameter where the insert makes contact, its widest rim, capped height and filled weight. A rim that projects beyond the body needs separate removal clearance.
review: Seat the filled jar and lower the lid onto the shoulder. Check for rim contact, lift the jar out and inspect the label where it passed the paperboard edge.

MTT-C0109.seoTitle: Custom Candle Jar Hexagonal tuck carton | MTT Packaging
MTT-C0109.seoDescription: Custom candle jar packaging with hexagonal tuck carton construction, coated folding boxboard and gloss varnish and vivid colour printing. Tailor size, artwork and quantity with MTT.
answer: A folded paperboard support holds the jar inside a six-sided carton. The clear distance between opposite flats controls fit for a round jar.
selection: Give the widest jar diameter and the capped height. Ask for the usable flat-to-flat dimension after the support is folded and the space occupied by the tuck lid.
review: Load a filled jar, fold in the dust flaps and close the tongue. Look for panels bowing outward, a tongue pressing against the cap or a support that shifts when the carton is lifted.

MTT-E0109.seoTitle: Custom Candle Jar Corrugated sleeve and tray | MTT Packaging
MTT-E0109.seoDescription: Custom candle jar packaging with corrugated sleeve and tray construction, kraft-lined corrugated board and two-colour printing. Tailor size, artwork and quantity with MTT.
answer: A corrugated tray carries the candle jar into a four-sided sleeve. Review the tray with its proposed paper support in place.
selection: Measure the filled jar including its cap and label, record its weight and mark the direction the tray will travel. Check the loaded tray height against the sleeve opening.
review: Slide the loaded tray through the sleeve from closed to fully open. Watch for the cap catching an edge or cushioning bunching ahead of the jar. Verify the complete shipping pack separately for the intended route.

MTT-R0203.seoTitle: Custom Chocolate Gift Magnetic Book Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0203.seoDescription: Custom chocolate gift packaging in a magnetic book box, with nine equal compartments for wrapped chocolates. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: The magnetic book box presents nine equal compartments for individually wrapped chocolates. Use the largest finished wrapper to define the cell envelope.
selection: Measure the wrapped length, width and height including twisted ends or folded seams. Lay out a full set of nine so adjoining wrappers and the lid lining are both accounted for.
review: Place a piece in the centre cell and fill its neighbours. Check that it lifts out without pulling an adjacent wrapper, then shut the lid and inspect the tallest piece for contact.

MTT-R0208.seoTitle: Custom Chocolate Bar Collection Two-Drawer Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0208.seoDescription: Custom chocolate bar collection packaging in a two-drawer box, with six wrapped-bar channels per drawer. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: Each shallow drawer presents six wrapped bars in parallel channels. A sealed wrapper end can extend beyond the length of the bar itself.
selection: Supply the finished wrapper length with both seals, the thickest cross-section and the front-facing artwork direction. Mark the end intended for finger access.
review: Fill both drawers with the intended assortment and slide each one shut. Watch for wrapper seams catching on the cabinet edge. Remove a middle bar with the adjacent channels still full.

MTT-R0219.seoTitle: Custom Celebration Chocolate Round Lift-Off Box | MTT Packaging
MTT-R0219.seoDescription: Custom celebration chocolate packaging in a round lift-off box, with radial compartments for wrapped sweets. Tailor size, wrapping paper and finishes with MTT. Request a quote.
answer: Radial compartments divide the round lift-off box. Each compartment narrows toward the centre, so its outer width alone cannot establish fit.
selection: Send the dimensions of the largest wrapped sweet and mark its intended orientation. On the insert drawing check the usable width at both ends of the sweet and the height below the lid.
review: Arrange a full ring of wrapped samples. Try removing one near the narrow end, check the dividers stay seated and close the cap over the tallest wrapper fold.
